story.day1.title: The Back Room
story.day1.body: Grandpa's marble factory closed years ago, but its debt is still around. This morning a note slipped under the door. Tekin squeezed the last marble in his pocket and walked to the back room of the Marble Palace. In the corner stood an old, dusty board with brass pegs: the Fate Board.
story.day1.note: “Ten days, ten installments. I'll collect today's share tonight. No delays, and we stay friends. — Sadık”
story.day1.info: Tip: Shoot a ball; the colored band it lands in decides the result. Ball Level only raises winnings, Board Level only raises the win chance. Once the installment is full, close the day and prestige.
story.day2.title: The Old Machine
story.day2.body: Nevin winked from behind the counter: “Not bad yesterday. I had the board moved from that dusty back room to the front hall. Oil its launcher well and it'll never tire you.” Colorful bulbs were glowing; the board's clatter was starting to feel familiar.
story.day2.note: “Yesterday's payment is fine. A bit more today. Interest grows, Tekin. — S.”
story.day2.info: Tip: The Ticket Tree opens at the end of each day; permanent upgrades make every new day easier. Daily caps rise every day.
story.day3.title: Smell of Polish
story.day3.body: The hall lights were brighter today. Nevin set a new bottle of polish on the counter: “They say a shiny marble wins more. Superstition, but it works.”
story.day3.note: “I hear there's a marble master in the neighborhood. Masters pay their debts. — S.”
story.day4.title: The Crowd
story.day4.body: The front hall was crowded today. Someone had bet everything on a single shot and was being watched with half cheers, half sighs. Tekin stuck to his plan: first the board, then the marble, then patience.
story.day4.note: “You're not halfway yet, but you're not at the start either. — S.”
story.day5.title: The Old Sign
story.day5.body: On the way he saw the sign of grandpa's old factory. Most letters had fallen off, but the word “MARBLE” was still readable. When he reached the hall, Nevin took him up to the Red Salon: “The Fate Board lives here now. You earned it.”
story.day5.note: “Day five. This is where people usually give up. You don't look like you will. — S.”
story.day6.title: The Peg Master
story.day6.body: Nevin poured two glasses of tea: “My late partner built this board. He hammered in every peg by hand. Choose your pegs carefully too.” For the first time Tekin noticed the small carvings on the board's edge.
story.day7.title: The Visitor
story.day7.body: A knock at the door. Mr. Sadık walked in, his shoes as shiny as marbles. He looked at the board, then at Tekin. “Carry on,” he said, and left.
story.day7.note: “I like what I see. Keep the pace. — S.”
story.day8.title: Night Shift
story.day8.body: The board had moved to the Night Hall, its neon freshly lit. The night guard now greeted Tekin by name. “The machine likes you,” he said. They both knew the machine liked no one, but it was a nice thing to say.
story.day9.title: The Final Stretch
story.day9.body: Tekin checked his ledger: almost done. He noticed his hands trembling, then realized it wasn't fear but excitement.
story.day9.note: “One day left. Come early tomorrow, the coffee's on me. — S.”
story.day10.title: The Last Marble
story.day10.body: The last installment is today. Nevin opened the Marble Palace's Grand Hall just for him; the chandeliers lit up. Tekin took the only marble left from the factory out of his pocket and set it on the counter. “It brings luck,” said Nevin. “Or it doesn't. But it looks nice.”
story.day10.info: Finish today's installment and the whole debt is paid off.
story.finale.title: The Note Torn in Two
story.finale.body: When the last payment came in, Mr. Sadık stood up and tore the promissory note in half. “You're like your grandfather,” he said. “He never gave up either.” When Tekin stepped outside, the evening sun was hitting the old factory sign. Maybe one day it would open again. For now, a glass of tea and a clattering board were waiting for him in the back room.
story.finale.note: Congratulations, you finished the main story! Close this day to unlock Free Mode: no installments, no daily caps, prestige any time.
story.free.title: First Debt-Free Morning
story.free.body: No note under the door this time. Tekin went to the Marble Palace anyway, just for fun. The Fate Board greeted him with its usual clatter.
story.free.info: Free Mode: daily caps are gone, Board Level can go all the way up. Prestige any time; the ticket reward is based on run profit. New achievements await.

phone.quiet: The phone is quiet. Someone will call sooner or later.
phone.voicemail_fined: Mr. Sadık left a voicemail… and took {v} from your cash!
phone.voicemail_spared: Mr. Sadık left a voicemail: “Pick up next time, Tekin.”
phone.nevin.1: Tekin, dear! The hall is empty and the machine is all yours. Go wild for a bit, it's on the house!
phone.nevin.2: I oiled the launcher with my own hands. Come on, shoot like there's no tomorrow!
phone.nevin.3: Your grandpa would be proud. Here, a few lucky seconds from me. Set that board on fire!
phone.guard.1: Psst, it's the night guard. I'll look the other way for a bit. Shoot all you want!
phone.guard.2: The boss stepped out. I jammed the limiter. Quick, before he's back!
phone.guard.3: Your grandpa did me a favor once. Now it's my turn. Go on, fire it up!
phone.sadik.1: Tekin. Just calling to say hello. Tonight's installment… it's coming, right?
phone.sadik.2: Funny, the ledger looks a little empty today. My boys get restless when they're bored.
phone.sadik.3: They say the machines are loud tonight. Don't make me come down there, Tekin.
phone.sadik_paid.1: Ah, you've already paid. A pleasure doing business with you.
phone.sadik_paid.2: Today's share is in. See? We're still friends.
phone.risk: Fine chance {p}: he'd take {r} of your cash ({v}).
phone.risk_hint: PAY NOW: {v} goes into today's installment (not lost) and there's no fine. HANG UP: he rolls the dice.
phone.fined: “Late fee, Tekin.” He took {v} from your cash.
phone.spared_paid: “Now that's what I like to see.” He hung up, satisfied.
wheel.owned_star: You already have this ball. Sell it below — or keep it as Mastery ★{n}/{m} (stronger ability).
wheel.owned_full: You already have this ball and its Mastery is full (★{m}/{m}). Sell it below.
phone.paid_ok: “That's what I like to hear.” {v} went into today's installment ({p} paid). No fine.
phone.paid_full: “Today's share is complete. See? We're still friends.” {v} went into the installment.
phone.paid_little: “That's it? Not enough, Tekin.” Only {v} went into the installment.
phone.sadik_empty.1: Tekin, I checked your ledger: not a cent has gone in today. That won't do. My boys are emptying your till.
phone.sadik_empty.2: The till is still empty, Tekin. So I've decided to protect you from yourself.
phone.sadik_empty.3: Not a single payment today? Then I'll take care of it. Your cash goes to the installment.
phone.collected: He seized {v} of your cash and put it into today's installment ({p} paid). He left you {l} to keep playing.
phone.collect_hint: The money isn't lost; it counts toward today's debt. Pay a little early each day and he won't do this.
phone.collect_nothing: He checked your till: nothing worth taking. “Have it by tonight, Tekin.”
phone.voicemail_collect: Mr. Sadık left a voicemail: “The till is empty.” He put {v} of your cash into the installment.
